name: wifi_status
summary: Report the Wi-Fi radio's power state and the network it is currently joined to (if any).

name: list_preferred_wifi
summary: List the preferred (remembered) Wi-Fi networks this Mac auto-joins, in priority order. Listing nearby/available networks isn't supported (needs elevated privileges) — use open_settings (pane 'wifi') to pick a new one.

name: bluetooth_status
summary: Report whether Bluetooth is on, which devices are currently connected, and which are paired but not connected. Turning Bluetooth on/off has no first-party command line on macOS — use open_settings (pane 'bluetooth').

name: power_status
summary: Report power and battery state: the current power source, battery charge and charging status, whether Low Power Mode is on, and battery health (condition, cycle count, maximum capacity) on machines with a battery.

name: about_this_mac
summary: Report what this Mac is: macOS version and build, model, chip/CPU, core count, memory, and serial number.

name: uptime
summary: Report how long this Mac has been running since its last boot (plus load averages).

name: disk_usage
summary: Report every mounted volume with its total size, used space, and free space (what Finder shows, in SI units).

name: software_update_check
summary: Check Apple's update service for pending macOS/software updates (read-only — never downloads or installs; installing is an open_settings hand-off). Contacts Apple's servers and can take up to a minute.

name: list_airplay_devices
summary: List AirPlay receivers (Apple TVs, AirPlay-capable TVs/speakers, other Macs) reachable on the local network right now — answers 'what can I mirror or stream to?'. Read-only discovery; it does NOT start mirroring (there is no command line to begin it) — hand that off with open_settings (pane 'displays'). May be empty if no receivers are on, and the host app may need Local Network access on first use.

name: list_input_sources
summary: List the enabled keyboard layouts and input methods (typing languages) and mark which one is currently active — answers 'what can I type in?'. Read-only. Adding/removing a language or switching the active source has no command line; hand that off with open_settings (pane 'keyboard').

name: open_settings
summary: Open a specific pane of System Settings. Use to hand off actions this server can't do directly — because they need admin rights (connecting/re-enabling a printer, joining a Wi-Fi network, battery/Low-Power settings) or have no command line at all (pairing a Bluetooth device, signing into iCloud, toggling a Focus, adding a keyboard language, starting screen mirroring). ALWAYS tell the user the exact click-path to finish in the opened pane — e.g. bluetooth: 'put the device in pairing mode, then click Connect next to it under Nearby Devices'; apple_id: 'sign in or manage iCloud here'; focus: 'turn a Focus like Do Not Disturb on or off here'; keyboard: 'Text Input > Input Sources > Edit, then + to add a language'; displays: 'the AirPlay/mirroring control is the + dropdown here'. Runs immediately; cannot be undone (it just opens a window).

params.name: pane
params.description: Which System Settings pane to open. 'focus' = Focus/Do Not Disturb; 'keyboard' = keyboard and input sources (add/change a typing language); 'apple_id' = Apple Account / iCloud; 'displays' = display arrangement and AirPlay screen mirroring.

name: notify
summary: Post a macOS notification banner to get the user's attention — e.g. to signal that a long-running task finished or that you need input. Runs immediately; cannot be undone (a shown notification can't be recalled). If nothing appears, the host app needs Notifications enabled in System Settings > Notifications.

params.name: title
params.description: The bold title line shown above the message.

name: speak
summary: Speak text aloud through the Mac's speakers using the system voice (text-to-speech). Use to get the user's attention audibly. Runs immediately; cannot be undone (audio plays at once). Text is capped at 2000 characters.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to speak aloud (up to 2000 characters).

name: display_sleep
summary: Put the display(s) to sleep immediately (turn the screen off) without sleeping the whole Mac. Runs immediately; cannot be undone from software — waking the screen is a manual action (press a key or move the mouse). Does not lock the Mac or stop any running work.

name: wifi_set_power
summary: Turn the Wi-Fi radio on or off. Staged for confirmation because turning Wi-Fi off disconnects this Mac from any Wi-Fi network. Reversible: undo restores the previous power state. To JOIN a specific network (rather than toggle the radio) there is no non-admin command — use open_settings (pane 'wifi').

params.name: power
params.description: Whether to turn the Wi-Fi radio 'on' or 'off'.
